Marketing Research Indonesia 
Frontier Research is a leading independent marketing research firm in Indonesia, serving local enterprises, government entities, and multinational corporations. With over two decades of experience, we employ both offline and online methodologies to deliver actionable insights, helping businesses navigate the diverse Indonesian market landscape.
Brand Equity Research Indonesia 
At Frontier Research, we specialize in brand equity research, providing businesses with in-depth analyses of brand awareness, loyalty, and customer perception across Indonesia's varied demographics. Our culturally-relevant methodologies and advanced analytics empower brands to strengthen their market positioning and long-term value.
How Frontier Research Can Help 
Frontier Research helps businesses in Indonesia make smarter, data-driven decisions through reliable and locally nuanced insights. Whether you're launching a new product, measuring brand performance, or exploring consumer behavior, our research solutions are designed to meet your unique objectives. With deep expertise in quantitative and qualitative methods, nationwide field capabilities, and a focus on practical outcomes, Frontier Research empowers brands to stay competitive and relevant in a dynamic market.
Market Research Agency 
As a premier market research agency in Indonesia, Frontier Research offers comprehensive services, including customer satisfaction surveys, behavioral studies, and pricing research. Our extensive network, comprising six direct branches, 24 indirect branches, and over 1,000 field interviewers, ensures nationwide coverage and reliable data collection.
